neet_phy_u18_t05_1.working: By definition, 1 u is one-twelfth of the mass of one neutral 12C atom, electrons included, not just the nucleus.

neet_phy_u18_t05_4.working: Proton = 1.007276 u (IV); neutron = 1.008665 u (I); hydrogen atom = 1.007825 u (III); 1 u is equivalent to 931.5 MeV (II).

neet_phy_u18_t05_5.working: A is true (1 u ≈ 1.66e-27 kg). B is false because the neutron is heavier than the proton. C is true because atomic masses include electrons. D is true: 35Cl is about 75% abundant, giving the NCERT value of about 35.47 u. E is false because H includes an electron, so it is heavier than a proton. Correct set is A, C, D.
